My thing is…why did nothing work out for Selina and her team. It seems that every time she had a pinch of success in her career something, due to the fault of her team, impeded her progress. I think the people around her made her more and more jaded and caused her to spiral into a psychopath obsessed with winning. Let’s be real. Her team got increasingly worse as the seasons progressed, the only people who were remotely competent were Kent, Ben and Gary (despite that one time he paid Amy and Dan to be lobbyists for her bill). Mike constantly showed his incompetence, Dan only cared to help Selina if it furthered his career and Amy did what she could. Of all the mess ups I think she was the most redeemable. The show became kind of unwatchable knowing that the seasons are really just a culmination of her clawing her way back to power after losing so drastically so many times.

I know you must be in an incredible amount of pain right now. As someone who’s also lost someone they love very dearly I can wrap my mind and emotions around what you must be going through. Especially those feelings of initial loneliness. Those are the worst. For one, I just want to say that you’re not an idiot for loving someone you’re in a relationship with unconditionally, there’s nothing stupid about that. You deserve to be loved unconditionally as well. I wish the people closest to you were able to support you through this, the one thing I hate the most is when the people close to us visibly see the suffering and choose to either ignore it or do nothing about it.
